newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks power ahead, set new record highs.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks power ahead, set new record highs.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended higher on Friday setting new record highs in both indices, after breaking key resistance levels in the afternoon, dealers said.
Traders said they expected stocks to extend gains on Monday morning.
The general index closed up 7.43 points, 1.59 pct, to 474.75, while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares ended up 85.4 points, 1.59 percent, to 5,470.23 points.
Traders noted that turnover was high at 111.15 billion pesetas.
Banking shares were among the best performers. BBV rose 4.05 pct, and Popular 3.08 pct.
Ahead of its forthcoming privatisation, Telefonica ended 1.8 percent higher at 3,375 in high volume of trade with 5.3 million of shares changing hands.
